title: Vigor y suelo desnudo por sector (Landsat, 30 m)
label: observado
reading: The Southeast sector had 16 % less greenness than the field's median and had little vegetation 44 % of the time. It is worth walking it: there may be patches of bare soil, erosion, compaction, salts or a low spot.
method: A 3 x 3 grid of sectors over the field; at each center, the Landsat NDVI series (HLS L30, 30 m) of the last 2 years. Each sector's mean NDVI is compared with the field's median.
limitations: Clouds and their shadows can lower the NDVI of some dates: medians per period are used.
Each sector is one 30 m pixel inside the field: it shows differences between sectors, not a continuous map.
It measures greenness, not yield or organic matter.
warnings: No AppEEARS credentials: no live data was queried.
Using SIMULATED SAMPLE DATA of NDVI: these are not observations of your field.
